title: Unique finite étale morphism lifting to quotient-power thickenings
statement: Let $f:R\to S$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings, $I=\ker(f)$, $z:\operatorname{Spec}(S)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ the induced morphism, and $V\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ an open [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $P,Q$ be finite étale covers of $V$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Set $U=z^{-1}(V)$. For each $n\geq0$ put $B_n=R/I^{n+1}$, let $j_n:\operatorname{Spec}(B_n)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R)$ be the quotient immersion, and let $P_n=P\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R)}\operatorname{Spec}(B_n)$, with projection $p_n:P_n\to P$. Factoring $f$ through $B_n$ induces $k_n:P\times_V U\to P_n$. For every $U$-morphism $\varphi:P|_U\to Q|_U$ and every $n$, there is a unique scheme morphism $g_n:P_n\to Q$ such that $g_n$ is over $V$ and $g_n\circ k_n=\operatorname{pr}_Q\circ\varphi$. No Noetherian, local-ring or depth hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Let q: R/(ker f)^(n+1) -> S be the quotient lift. Surjectivity of f makes q surjective. Its kernel is the image of ker f under the quotient map, whose (n+1)st power is zero by Ideal.ker_quotient_lift and Ideal.map_pow. Every prime ideal contains this kernel (apply prime membership to powers), so Spec(q) is surjective. It is a closed immersion by surjectivity of q, hence a universal homeomorphism.

Paste the pullback of P along the restricted section with the restriction square, then cancel the square defining Adic.cover using IsPullback.of_right. This proves that Adic.zeroMap is the base change of Spec(q). Universal homeomorphisms are stable under base change, so Adic.zeroMap is a universal homeomorphism.

Use the already proved full-faithfulness component (Stacks 04DY) of lemma-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-site-equivalence, namely Scheme.Hom.existsUnique_of_isPullback in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.EtaleTopologicalInvariance.FullyFaithful. The private helper first base changes an arbitrary etale target p along b, and then applies this lemma with the identity pullback square on the source. Projection of the descended section gives a lift g with both commuting triangles. Apply this helper to p=Q.obj.hom, i=Adic.zeroMap and b=Adic.coverMap followed by P.obj.hom. The given morphism phi supplies a, and pullback.condition and FiniteEtale.hom_left_comp verify its compatibility.

For another lift g′, the over-V equalities and restriction equalities coincide. Scheme.Hom.ext_of_surjective_of_formallyUnramified from the same fully-faithfulness module proves g′=g, since Adic.zeroMap is surjective and Q is etale. Assemble existence and uniqueness with the Lean ExistsUnique constructor. This works for n=0, zero rings, empty opens and varying cover ranks; no affine gluing infrastructure is added.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_adic_unique_lift
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (P Q : V.toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (φ : (FiniteEtale.pullback ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) ∣_ V)).obj P ⟶
      (FiniteEtale.pullback ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) ∣_ V)).obj Q)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! g : FiniteEtale.Adic.cover f V P n ⟶ Q.obj.left,
      g ≫ Q.obj.hom = FiniteEtale.Adic.coverMap f V P n ≫ P.obj.hom ∧
      FiniteEtale.Adic.zeroMap f V P n ≫ g =
        φ.hom.left ≫ pullback.fst Q.obj.hom
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f)) ∣_ V)
